# ChatBotKit Integration — manage chatbots via the Membrane CLI (short listing)

Selected by Skill Harbor — short listing (the discovery manifest carries no verifiable license for this skill — the manifest makes faith, so no content is reproduced): @membranedev's chatbotkit skill (by the Membrane team), an integration skill for working with ChatBotKit data. It teaches the agent to use the Membrane CLI: install the CLI (`npm install -g @membranehq/cli`), log in via the browser authorization flow (headless supported with code completion), connect to ChatBotKit with `membrane connection ensure`, then manage the ChatBotKit object model — Chatbots, Datasets and Entries, Completions, Files, Integrations, Knowledgebases and Articles — with connection state polling (READY / CLIENT_ACTION_REQUIRED / BUILDING) and JSON output flags. Honest caveats: license terms not verifiable — short listing with a link only, nothing copied; requires network access, a valid Membrane account (free tier supported), and your own ChatBotKit account/API access — the auth flow needs a real browser step at least once; follow the source link and read the terms yourself before use. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
